call_points.text: Induction cooktop output run-rate now 4-5 million units versus 2 million produced last year, with extra lines at Baddi.
Small appliances were 40.2% of Q4 revenue, with 12.7% value growth but 97.7% volume growth on a lower-ASP mix.
Working capital guided below 30 days and called sustainable, helped by channel financing and an MSME invoice platform.
Forex volatility is the main cost challenge management flagged; commodity increases are passed on quarterly.
Crystalline glass for induction cooktops is fully imported, 33-40% of imports by model, with no domestic capacity.
Induction cooktops saw massive demand surging 89.4% YoY in value during Q4FY26.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹414.52 Cr; net profit ₹6.05 Cr (+317.2% YoY).
Stove Kraft released its Q4 & FY26 investor presentation highlighting 32.4% YoY revenue growth and sharp debt reduction.
Stove Kraft reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹414.5 Cr (+32.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹6.1 Cr (+317.8% YoY) on May 12, 2026.
Stove Kraft Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call held on 13 May 2026 via its website.

On its 13 May 2026 Q4 & FY26 earnings call, Stove Kraft guided FY27 revenue growth above 15% and an EBITDA margin of at least 11%, with IKEA billing starting in Q1FY27 and induction cooktop capacity doubled to a 4-5 million unit run-rate.
Stove Kraft's board approved the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary and a 50:50 joint venture in China for manufacturing triply sheets.
Stove Kraft reported a ₹7,080 NSE penalty for a delayed shareholding pattern filing on May 25, 2026.
